skeleton.name: Skeleton
skeleton.purpose: Reserve known content structure while data is loading, refreshing, or hydrating without presenting fake content or fake progress.

variants.description: Compact chip, badge, or pill control loading.
Image, map, or visual module loading.
Dense data table loading with known row and column structure.

skeleton.statePrecedence: disabled > loaded > paused > stale > loading > default

Energy.decision: Use Energy for subtle surfaces and shimmer contrast.
Energy.behavior: Placeholder is visible without becoming content.

Voice.decision: Use Voice for loading labels on owning regions.
Voice.behavior: Assistive context names what is loading.

Frame.decision: Use Frame for dimensions, spacing, and radius.

Depth.decision: Use Depth only through parent surface.
Depth.rejectIf: Skeleton behaves like a toast or modal.

Momentum.decision: Use Momentum for shimmer and reduced-motion fallback.

State.decision: Use State for loading, stale, paused, loaded, and disabled.

Tone.decision: Use Tone to avoid promising content is ready.
Tone.behavior: Loading copy is calm and precise.

Growth.decision: Use Growth to escalate loading flows to patterns.

Symbol.decision: Use Symbol only in owning labels or status clusters.

Iconography.decision: Use Iconography only when parent context needs a loading symbol.
Iconography.behavior: Icon scale aligns with skeleton rhythm.

Accessibility.decision: Use Accessibility for aria-busy and decorative bones.
Accessibility.behavior: Bones are not exposed as content.
Accessibility.rejectIf: Bones are focusable or announced as content.

productExamples.example: Dense table loading with rows and columns.

dont: Do not create random gray blocks.
info: Use Progress Indicator when a real value exists.

agentInstructions: Use Skeleton only when the future content structure is known.
Ask when real progress, retry, cancel, or recovery is needed.
Do not expose bones as interactive content.

props.name: label
props.notes: Loading context for the owning region.

props.name: lines
props.notes: Number of text or row bones.

props.name: rows
props.notes: Number of table rows when variant is table.

props.name: columns
props.notes: Number of table columns when variant is table.

props.name: busy
props.notes: Sets aria-busy for the loading region.

props.name: state
props.notes: Maps loading, stale, paused, loaded, and disabled state treatment.

props.name: fullWidth
props.notes: Lets the placeholder fill the owning region when the future content is full-width.

props.name: width
props.notes: Optional placeholder width for direct structural bones.

props.name: height
props.notes: Optional placeholder height for direct structural bones.
